# Exceptions for hack/test/consistency_rbac_test.sh (CFC-3, openspec change
# cross-file-consistency-gates): triples of config/rbac/role.yaml that the chart's manager roles
# may NOT grant in one render mode.
#
# One triple per line:   <mode> <apiGroup> <resource> <verb> <reason>
#   mode      default | tenant  -- the render the line excuses, and only that one. A tenant line
#             never excuses a gap in the default render, and the reverse.
#   apiGroup  `core` for the core group ("").
#   reason    required, free text after the verb. A tenant line's reason starts with its class:
#               cluster-scoped:  the resource is cluster-scoped; tenant mode renders no
#                                ClusterRole and a Role cannot grant it (kollect.dev kinds are
#                                checked against the CRD scope, others against a built-in list)
#               team-workload:   a read (get/list/watch) of a workload kind a KollectTarget
#                                collects (TEAM_WORKLOAD_KINDS in the gate); tenant mode leaves
#                                that RBAC to the team
# A line the render does not need (the chart grants the triple, or role.yaml no longer has it)
# fails the gate as stale, so this list cannot outlive the gap it excuses.

# Tenant mode drops cluster scope (no ClusterRole is rendered).
tenant core namespaces get cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant core namespaces list cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant core namespaces watch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant authentication.k8s.io tokenreviews create cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant authorization.k8s.io subjectaccessreviews create cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant authorization.k8s.io selfsubjectaccessreviews create cluster-scoped: a Role cannot grant it (the tenant Role lists it to no effect); system:basic-user grants it to every authenticated user
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories create cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories delete cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories get cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories list cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories patch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories update cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories watch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories/finalizers update cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories/status get cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories/status patch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterinventories/status update cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterscopes get cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterscopes list cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclusterscopes watch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets create cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets delete cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets get cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets list cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets patch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets update cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets watch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets/finalizers update cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets/status get cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets/status patch cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope
tenant kollect.dev kollectclustertargets/status update cluster-scoped: tenant mode drops cluster scope

# Tenant mode leaves workload-collection RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3,
# "Workload collection RBAC (team)"). These reads come from the KollectTarget controller's
# markers for the GVKs the default samples collect, not from a reconciler need.
tenant apps deployments get team-workload: tenant mode leaves workload RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3)
tenant apps deployments list team-workload: tenant mode leaves workload RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3)
tenant apps deployments watch team-workload: tenant mode leaves workload RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3)
tenant cert-manager.io certificates get team-workload: tenant mode leaves workload RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3)
tenant cert-manager.io certificates list team-workload: tenant mode leaves workload RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3)
tenant cert-manager.io certificates watch team-workload: tenant mode leaves workload RBAC to the team (docs/examples/team-operator.md §3)
